name: B10-0281/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
The European Parliament backs the EU's new wastewater rules in full. These rules require the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries to pay most of the cost of removing medicine and cosmetics residues from wastewater. The Parliament rejects industry claims that this will cause medicine shortages or big price rises. It asks the European Commission not to weaken the rules under pressure, and asks Member States to use the flexibility already in the rules to protect supplies of generic medicines.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament states its position and asks others to act.
- **Who it affects:** Drug and cosmetics companies, water utilities, national governments, and households paying water bills.
- **What happens next:** Member States must write the rules into national law by July 2027; industry payments start from the end of 2028.
